title: Communal open space: 6 m2 per dwelling up to 300 m2 (Table 1.3a)
text: C1.3.1 Communal open space is provided for apartment development in accordance with Table 1.3a and the following: i. located in common property and behind the primary street setback line; ii. to be universally accessible to all occupants of the development; and iii. exclusive to the residential component of mixed-use development. Table 1.3a Provision of communal open space. Up to 10 dwellings: No provision. More than 10 dwellings: minimum communal open space provision 6m2 per dwelling up to maximum 300m2. Communal open spaces can be co-located with deep soil areas, soft landscaping area and/or co-indoor communal spaces.

replaces.note: R10-R25 apartments had no COS requirement (Part B 5.1.5 is grouped only)

notes: New here (no Chapter 3 equivalent; Chapter 3 has no communal open space element). Applies to developments of more than 10 dwellings (Table 1.3a 'Up to 10 dwellings: No provision'; rule condition). Threshold cliff: 11 dwellings need 66 m2 (C4P1-017). Table 2.5A: COS clauses need WAPC approval to modify (C4P1-018). Required area min(6 x dwellings, 300). Communal open space may be co-located with deep soil, soft landscaping and indoor communal spaces (table note).
